text:
Jake Sanderson has played only 11 of Ottawa's 19 games, and since returning he's piled up points: ten in his last ten. He's playing almost 25 minutes a night in that stretch, which tells you where he sits on the depth chart.

The underlying numbers are softer than usual. Ottawa has 49% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, worse than without him, and his shooting (4.8%) is low. Neither looks like a long-term problem for a player Evolving-Hockey had fifth of 215 defensemen in wins above replacement last season, much of it from the power play.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 96th percentile among defensemen for chances from the slot, an unusual skill from the back end. We'd watch the five-on-five share settle as he plays more. Our range: 48 to 73 points.
